root.label: chrono
root.note: Durations, time points and clocks with units in the type, plus C++20 calendars and time zones.

children.label: Durations
children.note: A count of type rep and a compile-time period in seconds.

children.label: Implicit conversion
children.note: Allowed only when lossless: to a finer integer unit or to a floating-point rep.

children.label: duration_cast
children.note: Explicit conversion that truncates toward zero, even for negative values.

children.label: floor ceil round
children.note: C++17 helpers: round goes to nearest and breaks ties toward the even value.

children.label: Common type
children.note: Mixed arithmetic uses the finer unit, so 2h + 30min is minutes{150}.

children.label: Division
children.note: Duration divided by duration is a unitless number, and integer reps truncate.

children.label: Overflow
children.note: Duration arithmetic does not check for overflow.

children.label: Signed rep
children.note: Overflow of the signed count is undefined behavior, with no saturation.

children.label: Nanosecond range
children.note: A 64-bit count of nanoseconds spans only about 292 years.

children.label: Constant evaluation
children.note: A constexpr overflow is rejected, which makes a handy compile-time check.

children.label: Clocks and time points
children.note: A time point is a duration since a clock's epoch.

children.label: system_clock
children.note: Wall-clock time that can jump; its epoch is Unix time since C++20.

children.label: steady_clock
children.note: Monotonic and the right clock for measuring intervals.

children.label: high_resolution_clock
children.note: May be an alias of system_clock or steady_clock, so prefer the other two.

children.label: C++20 clocks
children.note: utc_clock counts leap seconds; tai_clock and gps_clock do not; file_clock has an unspecified epoch.

children.label: Time point arithmetic
children.note: point minus point is a duration; point plus point does not compile.

children.label: Calendar types
children.note: C++20 value types for year, month, day and weekday.

children.label: Slash syntax
children.note: 2024y/February/29 builds a date; plain 2024/2/29 is integer division.

children.label: ok()
children.note: Invalid dates such as February 30 can be constructed, so check ok().

children.label: Month arithmetic
children.note: Adding months keeps the day without clamping, so January 31 plus a month is invalid.

children.label: sys_days
children.note: Day-precision system time point; an out-of-range day in a valid month normalizes.

children.label: Time zones
children.note: The IANA database reached through zoned_time.

children.label: sys vs local
children.note: sys_time is UTC and local_time has no zone, and they are distinct types.

children.label: Gap
children.note: A nonexistent local time makes the zoned_time constructor throw nonexistent_local_time.

children.label: Overlap
children.note: An ambiguous local time throws ambiguous_local_time unless choose is given.

children.label: Formatting
children.note: std::format understands durations, time points and dates.

children.label: Duration suffix
children.note: A duration prints its count followed by a unit suffix such as s or ms.

children.label: Chrono specs
children.note: Specs such as %F, %T, %H:%M and %Z select the fields to print.
